description: Source file defining the SubmitClaimRequestController class within the OrangeHRM Claim plugin. The class is responsible for handling the submission of claim requests, managing pre-render setup, and access control based on user roles and claim request validation.

classes.name: SubmitClaimRequestController
classes.description: Controller class for submitting claim requests, extending AbstractVueController and implementing CapableViewController. It manages pre-render setup, including passing data to the view, and access control based on claim request validation and user role management.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component for rendering by setting props such as claim ID, allowed file types, and maximum file size from the configuration service.

methods.name: isCapable
methods.description: Checks if the current user has permission to access the claim request based on its existence and the user's association with the employee number. Throws an exception if access should be denied.
